scope: Integration mapping and read-only acceptance tooling over the existing owner upload journal, P09 transition and attachment readers. Does not approve pending BA fields or create a location model.

P18-01.evidence_required: Exact release CI and authorized live replay/reconcile; existing parent, exact file/metadata/actor/session/warehouse/key.

P18-02.evidence_required: Authorized late-response, storage-failure and orphan handling; abort never proves rollback.

upload_identity.parent_id: Existing business document or warranty case UUID; never a P03 staging draft ID.
upload_identity.attachment_id: Server-allocated attachment UUID, not filename/hash/task ID.
upload_identity.trace_id: X-Request-ID / meta.request_id traces the HTTP request, not the upload operation.
upload_identity.auth_session: Stable across refresh. A new login must not automatically bind an old receipt to a new session.
upload_identity.checkpoint: Keep original file hash/name/size, owner form metadata and identity as permitted by local privacy policy. Never store access/refresh tokens or passwords in the checkpoint.

upload_result_rules.success: HTTP 201 plus valid meta.upload_receipt, exact parent/key/hash/scope and attachment ID; byte progress is not completion proof.
upload_result_rules.read: GET the matching owner attachments/requests/{operation_key}?warehouse_id=...&file_sha256=... . Read data.outcome, receipt and current_attachment separately.
upload_result_rules.unknown: CHECK_ONLY. No reupload or replacement/new key while result is unknown, even if aborted, progress=100%, hash matches a list row, or request_state=PENDING.
upload_result_rules.rejected: Owner rejection can include a QUARANTINED audit row. It is not a universal NOT_RECORDED or orphan-cleanup proof.
upload_result_rules.terminal_replay: Only the same request fingerprint/key replays a durable terminal result; do not interpret a replayed historical status/version as current byte access.
upload_result_rules.legacy: Requests without X-Upload-Contract have no journal guarantee. Never use the journal GET as fallback for a legacy upload.
upload_result_rules.error_note: These are source codes, not an exhaustive HTTP catalogue. Keep native owner auth/permission/validation/malware errors. Proxy non-JSON errors are not an owner permission diagnosis.

headers.Idempotency-Key: original P09 key, 8-100 characters per owner pattern
headers.X-Request-ID: original P09 request UUID, stable with the operation

reconcile.request_id_source: Original X-Request-ID UUID, NOT upload key or P09 Idempotency-Key

rules: Reuse native COMPLETED to RETURNED, scope, permission, optimistic version and component issue guards; never POST RETURNED from P18.
A successful historical UPDATE receipt does not replace a fresh authorized case read.
receiver, user handover date and checked checkbox are NOT in an approved structured P18 mapping; keep their submission disabled.
Do not concatenate structured form fields into note. UI limit 200 is stricter than P09 note validation max 2000; do not expand UI silently.
Server returned_at is not a user-entered handover date. Structured persistence/readback/privacy requires BA/owner decision.
Preserve P09 native retry policy; do not substitute upload REJECTED for warranty FAILED or turn PROCESSING/UNKNOWN into failure.

policy_separation.documents: PDF/JPEG/PNG/WEBP, 15 MiB per file, at most 20 ACTIVE; optional note max500 and document attachment purpose enum.
policy_separation.warranty: JPEG/PNG/WEBP images 10 MiB/max10 ACTIVE; video 300 MiB/300 seconds/max1 ACTIVE separately; warranty purpose enum and no note field.
policy_separation.scan_result: UNSCANNED is not CLEAN. Never show malware PASSED without evidence. QUARANTINED is not a downloadable file.
deployment_requirements: Receipt retention and operator orphan reconciliation

viewer_location.binary: Owner download rechecks parent/type/ID/ACL and ACTIVE state. Do not use receipt success as byte authorization; 401/403/QUARANTINED/DELETED cannot fall back to cached bytes.
viewer_location.client: Revoke object URLs on unmount or actor/session/context change; never forward Bearer across redirects or arbitrary storage hosts. Verify actual response headers/content type/size/checksum in authorized deployment smoke.
viewer_location.location: No authoritative pallet/tray/bin occupancy/capacity hierarchy. Show unavailable/NOT_TRACKED, not stock-by-warehouse or location_hint as a grid. Selecting a UI cell is not a stock/location write.

acceptance_tools.default_gates: OFF; only one explicitly approved read per invocation; redirects disabled; token only in unexported local environment.
acceptance_tools.coverage: Auth read, three owner metadata lists and three opt-in upload reconciliations. Not upload/handover/cleanup/binary/scanner/hardware tests.
acceptance_tools.evidence: Exact SHA and migration status plus approved account/file/parent, Request-ID, timestamp and redacted HTTP status/body. Workflow/source/health/collection pass alone never closes live acceptance.
